questions.question: Which animal has the longest migration of any mammal?
questions.hint: Some caribou herds migrate over 4,000 kilometers (2,500 miles) each year in search of food.

questions.question: Which rainforest is the largest in the world?
questions.hint: The Amazon Rainforest covers much of South America and is home to millions of plant and animal species.

questions.question: Which actor portrayed Jack Sparrow in the Pirates of the Caribbean films?
questions.hint: Johnny Depp's performance as Captain Jack Sparrow became one of the most iconic movie roles of the 2000s.

questions.question: Which fictional city is protected by Batman?
questions.hint: Batman protects Gotham City from criminals like the Joker, Penguin, and Riddler.

questions.question: Which invention made long-distance communication possible before telephones?
questions.hint: The telegraph transmitted messages using electrical signals and Morse code.

questions.question: Which branch of government is mainly responsible for creating laws in many democracies?
questions.hint: The legislative branch debates and passes laws for a country.

questions.question: Which civilization is credited with inventing paper?
questions.hint: Paper was invented in ancient China around the 2nd century AD and transformed education and communication.

questions.question: Which famous explorer completed the first successful voyage around the world?
questions.hint: Although Magellan died during the journey, his expedition completed the first circumnavigation of Earth.

questions.question: In which sport would you perform a slam dunk?
questions.hint: A slam dunk is one of basketball's most exciting scoring plays.

questions.question: Which country hosts the famous Tour de France cycling race?
questions.hint: The Tour de France is one of the world's most prestigious cycling competitions.

questions.question: Which is the longest mountain range in the world?
questions.hint: The Andes stretch over 7,000 kilometers along the western coast of South America.

questions.question: Which country has the largest number of time zones?
questions.hint: Including its overseas territories, France officially spans 12 time zones.

questions.question: Which is the hardest natural substance found on Earth?
questions.hint: Diamonds are made of carbon atoms arranged in an extremely strong crystal structure.

questions.question: Which blood type is known as the universal donor?
questions.hint: O-negative blood can usually be given to patients of any blood type during emergencies.

questions.question: Which country is the birthplace of the Olympic Games?
questions.hint: The ancient Olympic Games began in Olympia, Greece, over 2,700 years ago.

questions.question: Which language has the largest number of native speakers worldwide?
questions.hint: Mandarin Chinese has more native speakers than any other language.

questions.question: Which ocean animal has eight arms?
questions.hint: An octopus has eight flexible arms equipped with powerful suction cups.

questions.question: Which country is home to the city of Rio de Janeiro?
questions.hint: Rio de Janeiro is one of Brazil's most famous cities, known for Christ the Redeemer and Carnival.

questions.question: Which scientist developed the theory of relativity?
questions.hint: Albert Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

questions.question: Which famous monument in Paris was completed in 1889?
questions.hint: The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's Fair and has become a symbol of France.
